# Project Standards and Readiness TODOs

Track deferred gaps and unresolved readiness work here. Each item should cite a rule ID or project decision where applicable.

## Format

```markdown
### [TODO-ID] [Priority] [Rule ID] — Short title

- **Status:** Planned
- **Affected area:** [path or component]
- **Evidence:** [what was observed]
- **Risk:** [what can go wrong]
- **Next action:** [smallest useful next step]
- **Dependencies:** [prerequisites]
- **Owner:** [person/team/agent]
- **Target:** [date or milestone]
```

Keep completed work in project history or the relevant decision record. Do not delete a deferred item without recording how it was resolved.
